name: Project Desert Gods
source:
Welcome to the city called Eskendereya, the city of Egyptian gods and myth. Here you find a reinterpretation of those gods in a modern day but in a sci-fi setting. This visual novel will explore this setting and it's people through the life's of different types of life, through mortals and the gods.

[From [url=https://project-desert-gods.itch.io/desertgods]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到Eskendereya，埃及诸神与神话之城。在这里，你将看到科幻背景下、身处现代的诸神的全新演绎。这部视觉小说，将通过凡人与神明等不同生命的生活，探索这个世界及其居民。

[摘自[url=https://project-desert-gods.itch.io/desertgods]Itch.io[/url]]
